E4Plus1.uk.description: In the Naked Attraction studio, former club rep Chris hopes to meet someone to settle down with. Technophobe Louise wants an old-fashioned gentleman to sweep her off her feet. (S3 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners
E4Plus1.uk.description: Will's Birthday: Will plans a suitably grown-up dinner to celebrate his birthday, but his event clashes with a far more popular party, leaving his friends with a dilemma. (S2 Ep3/6) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners
E4Plus1.uk.description: Night Out in London: Will decides that the lads should be 'the boys who go to clubs'. They head to the West End, meeting aggressive bouncers and angry bus passengers. (S2 Ep4/6) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Two new couples join the experiment. But when big personalities clash, the marriages threaten to unravel before the honeymoons have even begun... (S13 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Vicky Pattison: Maybe, Baby?
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Vicky and her husband Ercan face a big decision; should they start a family? Vicky gives motherhood a trial run and sees how her frozen embryos are getting on. (Ep1/2) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dave Kim's Party: With Dave Kim's parents out of town for the weekend, Adam decides to throw a giant party to impress Brea. (S7 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Body Swap: Adam is thrilled about William Penn's new open lunch policy. And Geoff gets more than he bargained for when he uses Barry's student ID. (S7 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The One with All the Pigs: Billy believes the sty's the limit as he plans a pig-themed wedding involving a world-record parade of porkers. Will bride Steph kick up a stink at Billy's plans?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Can Warren trust Jenson? Diane makes a decision as her family struggle with her prognosis. And a resident is forced to reveal the truth.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: With things looking up, Donny proposes to Misbah, but it's not long before their bubble bursts... Elsewhere, Cleo struggles to re-adjust to life at home, and a relationship is on the rocks.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sheep.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Zocalo: Gordon Ramsay visits a floundering Mexican restaurant which has become an albatross around the necks of its owners, married couple Greg and Mary Russell. (S5 Ep12) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Fish Story: After Geoff vows to rekindle Erica's interest in music, she auditions for a campus a cappella group. Beverly forces Adam and Murray to go camping. (S7 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Schmoopie's Big Adventure: When Adam's birthday arrives, Beverly takes drastic measures to keep him from growing up too fast. (S7 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Benched: When Luke and Manny's hot-tempered basketball coach quits in the middle of a game, Jay and Phil both jockey to fill the position. (S1 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Travels with Scout: When Phil's dad turns up in a mobile home with a little four-legged friend, Claire thinks he might be hiding an ulterior motive for his visit. (S1 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Two new couples join the experiment. But when big personalities clash, the marriages threaten to unravel before the honeymoons have even begun... (S13 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Medical student Alice dates Max, the self-styled 'Wolf of Wallington High Street'. Veteran house music groover Mark meets Alison, a call centre worker by day and raver by night. (S17 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Spin a Yarn: Gordon tries to save the struggling Spin a Yarn restaurant in California. Despite an expensive refurbishment, the business is tearing apart its owners' marriage. (S5 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Simpson Tide: Homer, Barney and Moe become trapped in a nuclear submarine in a combat situation. Then Homer accidentally ejects the captain (guest star Rod Steiger). (S9 Ep19/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gone Abie Gone: Grampa goes missing. Can Homer and Marge find him by following clues from when he used to work in a restaurant? (S24 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Halloween: Claire, who loves Halloween, ropes in the whole family to spookify the Dunphy house, but none of it goes quite to plan. (S2 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Chirp: Claire and Haley have a bit of quality girl time while they're stuck at home sick. Phil is preoccupied by the taunts of a chirping smoke detector. (S2 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Two new couples join the experiment. But when big personalities clash, the marriages threaten to unravel before the honeymoons have even begun... (S13 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Dance Moms: A New Era
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Living on a Prayer: Glo selects new girl Miah to lead the group dance. And meddlesome mom Jing has a plan to force her own daughter into another girl's solo. (S2 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hardly Kirk-ing: Bart and Milhouse explore the perks of adulthood when a hair-shaving experiment leaves Milhouse looking exactly like his dad Kirk. (S24 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gorgeous Grampa: The family discover that Grampa used to be a top wrestler. And Mr Burns - a big fan - convinces him to get back in the ring... (S24 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Froggy supports his grandson. Donny visits a former flame. And a mother is horrified by what she overhears...

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Australia - Brand new series: The two new couples go on honeymoon, where there's an unlikely third wheel and frank confessions, and a groom's views infuriate his new wife. (S13 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Vicky Pattison: Maybe, Baby?
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Vicky and Ercan meet a mum who had her children through surrogacy and an adoptive mum. But are they any closer to deciding whether parenthood is right for them? (Ep2/2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch Wheel of Fortune, Trigger Point, Love Is Blind, Boarders, Michael McIntyre's Big Show and more. (S23 Ep2)
